propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing uvicorn mid-review before it can vote on changes
the reconciler retry path (reconcile_loop) is unprotected by the shutdown queue drain that protects webhook-queued reviews, so killed reviews cannot self-heal during a deploy burst
when deploy gaps are shorter than review duration, changes can live-lock with LLM-Review=0 while all health signals read green, because a killed review emits no VOTER_ERROR
autodeploy now defers recreation if in_flight > 0 (bounded by DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX=1800s keyed to the deferral episode), polling the /health endpoint's new in_flight field to detect busy state
the deferral is logged as AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED (informational) and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT (paging) to make the failure mode observable where it was previously invisible
during a landing burst with commits faster than review completion, the deferred autodeploy coalesces into one recreation at the newest tip, preventing review interruption across the burst
